description: Work with Sigma's workbooks: export them as PDF, Excel or CSV, email them now or on a schedule, and refresh materializations. Manage members and teams, list connections, data models and workspaces, and start workflows when workbooks, members, teams or data models are added or changed.

output.account_type: Their account type, such as Viewer or Creator.

output.account_type: Their account type, such as Viewer or Creator.
output.member_id: The member's id, for 'Get member' or 'Add or remove team members'.

sigma_computing_new_team_trigger.description: Runs for each team created in Sigma. Teams there before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.name: The team's name.
output.team_id: The team's id, for 'Add or remove team members'.

sigma_computing_new_workbook_trigger.description: Runs for each new workbook the connection can see. Workbooks made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The workbook's name.
output.updated_by: The member who last changed it.
output.url: A link to open it in Sigma.
output.workbook_id: The workbook's id, for 'Export workbook' or 'Send workbook'.

sigma_computing_workbook_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a workbook the connection can see is changed and saved. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.name: The workbook's name.

output.workbook_id: The workbook's id, for 'Export workbook' or 'Send workbook'.
